result.summary: The page is generally polished, but the fixed bottom navigation visibly obscures the second restaurant card and several horizontal carousels end with partially clipped items.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar covers the lower portion of the second popular restaurant card, hiding its image and content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page so cards can be fully viewed above the navigation bar, including safe-area spacing.

issues.description: The category carousel and fastest-near-you carousel show partially clipped items at the right edge, including a cut-off category pill and restaurant card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousels have intentional overflow behavior and a small trailing inset, or provide a clearer scroll affordance so clipped cards look deliberate.
